project_type: Fullstack monorepo - Next.js 15 frontend + NestJS backend
test_framework: Jest for backend, Vitest for frontend
build_command: pnpm run build (from root, builds both apps)
test_command: pnpm run test (from root, tests both apps)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install from root. 2. Run pnpm run build. 3. Run pnpm run lint. 4. Run pnpm run test.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via npx prisma generate. Migrations via npx prisma migrate dev.
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install from root. 2. Copy .env.example to .env in each app. 3. npx prisma generate in backend. 4. npx prisma migrate dev in backend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node.js 22, pnpm 10. MySQL not pre-installed - use SQLite for dev/testing or Docker MySQL.
contribution_requirements: Enterprise-grade clean code, modular architecture, reusable components, mobile-first UI, TypeScript strict mode.
key_patterns: Monorepo with apps/web (Next.js) and apps/api (NestJS). Shared packages in packages/ for types, utils, validation schemas. Prisma schema in apps/api/prisma/. shadcn/ui components in apps/web/src/components/ui/. Feature-based module organization in NestJS.
directory_structure: Monorepo structure: /apps/web (Next.js 15 App Router), /apps/api (NestJS), /packages/shared (shared types/zod schemas), /packages/ui (shared UI if needed)
